test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

There are various legends associated with the _______ of the state of Kerala.
solution: The correct answer is '**origin**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**origin**'. • It means the** 'country, race, culture, etc. that a person comes from'.** (व्यक्ति का देश, जाति, संस्‍कृति आदि जिससे उसका मूलतः संबंध है; मूल) • *Example: people of African **origin**...* **Correct Sentence:__** *There are various legends associated with the __**origin**__ of the state of Kerala.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **source**: a place, person, or thing where something comes or starts from or where something is obtained. (स्‍थान, व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु जो किसी का उद्‌गम, प्रारंभ या प्राप्ति का बिंदु हो; स्रोत, उद्‌गम, मूल) • **basis**: the principle or reason which lies behind something. (विचारधारा; विश्‍वास आदि का आधार) • **root**: the basic cause, source, or origin of something. (किसी चीज का मूल कारण, स्रोत या उत्पत्ति) 208:Tb56, The correct answer is '**Attract**'.
